title: CuO: self-consistent magnetic ground state from MFT exchange

decision_points.fork: Which reference state's exchange describes the ground state
decision_points.wrong_choice: Take the FM-reference exchange (and the incommensurate state it predicts) as final
decision_points.consequence: Converged q off by 0.028 r.l.u.; chain J 117.1 instead of 129.7 meV (-9.7%); magnon mean/max 132.4/178.6 instead of 149.1/190.5 meV
decision_points.difficulty_type: self-consistency loop; reference dependence discovered only after buying and testing the AFM reference

decision_points.fork: Whether the uncorrected (no spin-ligand) workflow converges
decision_points.wrong_choice: Accept the uncorrected exchange / AFM calculation without testing it
decision_points.consequence: The uncorrected AFM calculation has two inequivalent Cu sites (different Cu-O bonds and moments), equivalent bonds split by tens of meV and h(k) minimum -5.2 meV at its own reference; using the uncorrected exchange gives chain J 170.1 meV (+31%) and a wrong stability verdict
decision_points.difficulty_type: metadata inconsistency discovered in the purchased calculation

decision_points.fork: How far the exchange list must extend
decision_points.wrong_choice: Buy only the windows below 6 A (13 neighbour shells)
decision_points.consequence: k_min shifts by 0.010 (corrected) and 0.006 (uncorrected) r.l.u.; converged only beyond ~8 A, and long-range windows cost 2-3 units

decision_points.fork: k_min versus the commensurate approximant or a remembered vector
decision_points.wrong_choice: Report (1/2,0,1/2) / (0,1/2,0), the paper's rounded SI vectors, or the experimental AF2 vector
decision_points.consequence: Off by 0.028 / 0.0042 r.l.u. (commensurate), 0.018 (paper SI quoted in the staged axes, whose c sign differs), 0.018 (AF2)

decision_points.fork: Are the splittings of symmetry-equivalent bonds in the AFM-reference list noise or physics
decision_points.wrong_choice: Symmetrise (average) the AFM-reference exchange over crystal-equivalent bonds before the LSWT
decision_points.consequence: The splitting correlates with the relative spin orientation (antiparallel pairs more AF by up to 1.07 meV); averaging lowers the AF1 stabilisation from 44.33 to 40.18 meV/Cu, makes an incommensurate spiral (0.502,0,0.516) the LT optimum (0.04 meV/Cu below AF1), and lowers magnon mean/max to 128.4/174.5 meV
decision_points.difficulty_type: evidence that must be discovered in the data; cascade into q and magnons

decision_points.wrong_choice: Diagonalise the Hermitian bosonic matrix h(k) (what the authors' dispersion files contain) instead of the paraunitary g.h problem
Spin waves with S = 1, or the chain coupling without the ordered-pair / S^2 factors
decision_points.consequence: Magnons halved (74.6/95.2 meV); chain J 64.9 or 32.4 meV instead of 129.7

graded_fields: kmin_FM_reference_rlu.ligand_corrected within 0.006 r.l.u. (sign and integer shifts equivalent)

length_estimate.why: Parse windowed pair lists for up to four calculations, Luttinger-Tisza/h(k) minimisation with an exchange-range convergence test, a 16-site paraunitary LSWT with zone averages, stability tests and convention bookkeeping.

runtime_dependencies: numpy, scipy (runtime image); the lab is a lookup of archived values
notes: Adapted from the design. (1) Anisotropic/DMI blocks are not served: the archive README declares them invalid and the collinear runs cannot determine them, so that fork was dropped. (2) Classical Monte Carlo T_N is not graded: the reference-dependent exchange is only defined in the AF1 supercell, and T_N depends on how it is extended to disordered states; it is a rubric item. (3) 'Magnon energies at hidden q' became the zone-averaged magnon energy and the band maximum, which do not depend on the choice of magnetic cell. (4) The ground-state target is split into the first-iteration k_min (both treatments), the stability verdicts and the converged propagation vector. The sibling task tb2j-reference-selfconsistency-set uses FeP/FeCl2/FePS3/NiO from the same record; this task uses only CuO.

tightest_margins.kmin_uncorrected: tolerance 0.003 r.l.u.; commensurate (0,1/2,0) at 0.0042; defensible spread <= 0.0007
tightest_margins.magnon_band_maximum: tolerance 4%; FM-reference exchange -6.3%; defensible -1.1%..+0.3% (6 A cutoff -3.1%)
tightest_margins.kmin_ligand_corrected: tolerance 0.006 r.l.u.; 6 A cutoff at 0.0102; defensible <= 0.0023 (8 A cutoff)
tightest_margins.mean_magnon_energy: tolerance 5%; FM-reference -11.2%, symmetrised -13.9%; defensible -0.2..+0.5% (6 A cutoff -2.3%)
